description:
As the DHIS2 System Administrator, you need to configure automated maintenance jobs to ensure data on dashboards is up-to-date. 

Log in to DHIS2 (admin / district) and navigate to the 'Scheduler' app. Create two new scheduled jobs:

1. A job named 'Nightly Analytics Tables' that runs the 'Analytics table' job type daily at 2:00 AM.
2. A job named 'Weekly Resource Tables' that runs the 'Resource table' job type every Sunday at 3:00 AM.

Ensure both jobs are enabled.
